name: Polarity Shift (Contrast & Tension)
axiom: Change the sign of the sentence; the audience feels the drop before the numbers.
trigger: Slides making urgency felt, where a flat list of risks has stopped registering.

steps.text: Establish the positive state in one clause.
Turn it in the next clause, without a hedge.

antiPattern.violation: A turn in every sentence, which stops reading as contrast and starts reading as alarm.
antiPattern.remediation: Spend the shift once, at the point where the decision changes. Repeating it flattens it.
